title: Knewrall Engram Header
description: Line-1 JSON header of a .engram file (short-term memory / context folding). Written exactly once, at fold time, and never rewritten — the .engram file is write-once/immutable. All MUTABLE per-engram state (unfolds, last_unfold_at, ttl_at, consolidated_to, archived_path) lives in the owning session's session.json instead, never in this header. See short-term-memory-layer-plan.md §1.4 for why (bumping a stat in a variable-length JSON header line would force a full atomic rewrite of a file up to max_session_bytes on every single `unfold`).

key.description: Content-addressed key: sha256(payload_bytes) truncated to 10 hex chars, extended by 2-hex-char increments on collision. This is the FINAL (possibly disambiguated) key — filename is <key>.engram.

session.description: session_id (full, not the 8-char short form) that folded this engram

kind.description: ContentRouter classification, drives the digest strategy (Phase 2)

cmd.description: The command that produced this content, if any

path.description: Source file path, if this folded a file

label.description: Agent-supplied human-readable reason for the fold

bytes.description: Payload byte count, UNCOMPRESSED (Kimi K3 I11 — est_tokens must be derived from this, not the on-disk compressed size, once Phase 4 gzip lands)

est_tokens.description: ceil(bytes/4) — deliberately crude, never a tokenizer dependency

digest.description: Type-aware compressed summary retained inline in the fold marker

keywords.description: Locally/deterministically extracted identifier-shaped tokens, file path components, error class names — the only thing fold-scan searches, never the blob

encoding.description: Payload encoding on disk. 'raw' (default) until Phase 4 gzip lands for blobs over compress_over_bytes.

protected.description: True if source.path resolved under neurons/, notes/, or archive/ at fold time (path-based durability check — NOT checksum-based, since system.checksum is unpopulated in this codebase). Write-once; never toggled after fold. Skipped by TTL GC.
